scientific_integrity: Analytic sector proof; finite numerical checks are corroboration only. Priority is qualified by incomplete literature-wide coverage.
scientific_limitations: A passive energy-diagonal qubit and one nondegenerate equally spaced finite Gibbs ladder under a single energy-conserving unitary; no claims for arbitrary bath spectra, catalysis, repeated resets, coherent inputs or interacting driving.
title: Sharp finite thermal-reservoir dimension for qubit ergotropy activation
